So Good To You | "So Good To You" is a song that was written by Lynsey de Paul, and first released by Zakatek (aka Lenny Zakatek) as the B-side to his 1973 single, "I Gotcha Now", which also penned by de Paul.  The single was released in 2 March 1973 and both songs were produced and arranged by de Paul.  Her own version appeared in October 1973 as the B-side to her award-winning single "Won't Somebody Dance with Me", which was arranged by Christopher Gunning and produced by de Paul.  In Japan, however, "So Good To You" was released as the A-side with "Won't Somebody Dance with Me" being relegated to the B-side on its release in 1974.  All Music lists "So Good to You" as one of De Paul's song highlights.  De Paul's version appeared for the first time on CD in 1996 on the album "Greatest Hits" and later as a track on the CD compilation "Sugar & Beyond: Anthology 1972-1974".
